description: The committed resource outcome of add, replace, enable, disable, or remove ({§functionality-mutation-status}): 202 when the resulting definition requires authorization; otherwise 201 when add or replace creates a local definition (including an inherited override), or 200 for assignment to an existing local definition and settled enable/disable/remove. Only replace may change a different local definition. A mutation names the one alias it concerned, or, for an add that names its definitions by their content ({§functionality-addressing}), lists every definition it admitted.
title: FunctionalityMutationResult

definitions.description: Every definition an addressing family's add admitted, in the order the body named them.
